statement: At research_map/class_separation.py sha256 c266dbceca87 (read 2026-09-12T00:20, unchanged during the audit), the unknown-class-token detector used by findings_for_text has two representational defects, demonstrated by a labelled probe corpus: (a) its token regex AF-[A-Z0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+ requires four hyphen groups after AF, so a 4-component unknown class-shaped token of the frozen-WCC shape (probe AF-WCC-VAC-NONGEN) is never flagged, and it cannot match the frozen ids AF-WCC-VAC-GEN or AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH at all; (b) a 6+-component token is silently truncated to its first 5 components, so AF-SCC-C0-CH-VAC-GEN is reported as AF-SCC-C0-CH-VAC and AF-AAA-BBB-CCC-DDD-EEE as AF-AAA-BBB-CCC-DDD. The detector's own regression corpus still scores PASS (tp=17 fn=0 tn=10 fp=0, size 27) because that corpus contains no 4-component or >=6-component unknown tokens. On the same bytes, the four canonical artifacts at pinned hashes (formulation_taxonomy.yaml#276009f4, af_wcc_vacuum.yaml#9a8bd4c9, af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml#b6123750, af_scc_c0_vacuum.yaml#1bb78ce9) carry zero non-frozen class tokens under an independent maximal-match scan except one bare family reference AF-SCC at formulation_taxonomy.yaml line 37, which the project checker does not report; check_class_schema.py exits 0 (verdict pass) on F1/F2a/F2b. This is a verifier-layer finding, not a gate verdict.
